section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Study 1 Discussion', discusses findings related to self-evaluation measures, specifically the RSES, Self-Liking, Self-Competence, and Self-Deceptive Enhancement (SDE). It highlights that the RSES primarily measures self-liking with a minor self-competence component, and that the similarity between RSES and SDE is specific to self-liking. Self-Competence was found to be distinct due to its stronger associations with Conscientiousness and Openness.
